title: Update user manual to reflect demo UI toolbar buttons
body:
[Issues]
The existing English and Japanese user manuals accurately described most of the application's functionality but were missing explicit references to several prominent toolbar buttons available in the demo environment's UI. Specifically, the manuals lacked mentions of the "Add Item", "Add Image", "History / Diff", "Graph View", and "Keyboard & accessibility help" buttons.

[Changes]
- `docs/user-manual/index.md`: Added descriptions for the "Add Item", "Add Image", "History / Diff", "Graph View", and "Keyboard & accessibility help" buttons in their respective sections to accurately reflect the demo UI.
- `docs/ja/user-manual/index.md`: Applied the exact same updates to the Japanese documentation, using accurate translations for the button labels and instructions to maintain strict content parity.

[Verification Results]
- All temporary scratchpad/testing files were cleaned up and removed.
- Verified content parity and formatting using `npx prettier --write`.
- Ran unit tests across the `client`, `server`, and `shared` workspaces to ensure no regressions were introduced. All tests passed successfully.

---
